book.cleanvillage.story.0.page1:
Hello, whoever reads this.

My name is %1$s. A few weeks ago a terrible storm burst through the roof and water got in everywhere.
book.cleanvillage.story.0.page2:
When the rain finally stopped, everything was covered in mud and mold started creeping out of the corners.

I didn't know where to start...
book.cleanvillage.story.0.page3:
Since then I just sit on my bed all day.

My cleaning things are in this chest. If you help me, I will never forget it.

- %1$s
book.cleanvillage.story.1.page1:
Hello, traveler.

I'm %1$s. I spent a whole year visiting my cousin in the desert. So much sand, so much sun!
book.cleanvillage.story.1.page2:
When I came back, my house wasn't mine anymore: cobwebs, dust up to the ceiling and windows so dirty no light gets in.

The spiders even had names.
book.cleanvillage.story.1.page3:
I'm so tired I can't even begin.

I'm leaving my sponges here. Could you give me a hand?

- %1$s
book.cleanvillage.story.2.page1:
Dear stranger,

I'm %1$s. I was sick all winter long, stuck in bed with a fever and beetroot soup.
book.cleanvillage.story.2.page2: Meanwhile the house got dirtier and dirtier. First dust, then stains, then... that green stuff in the corners.
book.cleanvillage.story.2.page3:
I feel better now, but seeing it like this breaks my heart.

If you have a moment, my cleaning things are in this chest.

- %1$s
book.cleanvillage.story.3.page1:
Hi.

My name is %1$s. One night I forgot to sweep the chimney and... whoosh! Black smoke filled the whole house.
book.cleanvillage.story.3.page2: Nothing burned, thankfully, but soot covered everything: walls, floor, windows. Even my cat came out grey.
book.cleanvillage.story.3.page3:
I tried to clean it myself, but I only spread the mess around.

I'm leaving the cleaning kit here. Please, help me.

- %1$s
book.cleanvillage.story.4.page1:
Hello, brave one.

I'm %1$s. One night a spider came in. Then two. Then... well, I lost count.
book.cleanvillage.story.4.page2: They left when the cold came, but they left cobwebs in every corner and everything full of dust and stains.
book.cleanvillage.story.4.page3:
It makes me so sad to see my house like this that I don't even go out to trade.

Everything you need is in this chest. The sponge even wipes away cobwebs!

- %1$s
book.cleanvillage.story.5.page1:
To whoever finds this:

I'm %1$s. Pillagers raided the village and stomped into my house with muddy boots.
book.cleanvillage.story.5.page2: They broke the lanterns, trampled everything and left the walls a disaster. Now it's dark and smells like a swamp.
book.cleanvillage.story.5.page3:
They're gone now, but I'm still sitting here not knowing what to do.

If you could help me make it like before... the kit is in the chest.

- %1$s
book.cleanvillage.letter.0.page1:
Dear %2$s,

My house is sparkling! Not a single drop of mud left, and the mold has moved somewhere else (far away, I hope).
book.cleanvillage.letter.0.page2:
Thank you from the bottom of my heart. There will always be a seat for you at my table.

With love, and smelling of soap,
%1$s
book.cleanvillage.letter.1.page1:
Dear %2$s,

Look at those windows! So much sunlight gets in now that it feels like the desert again, but without the sand.
book.cleanvillage.letter.1.page2:
The spiders wrote to complain. I told them I was very sorry (I'm not).

Thank you, truly.
%1$s
book.cleanvillage.letter.2.page1:
Dear %2$s,

You can't imagine what it means to come back to a clean home after such a long winter.
book.cleanvillage.letter.2.page2:
I feel brand new. Drop by for some beetroot soup whenever you like. No fever this time.

Your friend,
%1$s
book.cleanvillage.letter.3.page1:
Dear %2$s,

Goodbye, soot! The walls have their color back and my cat is orange again.
book.cleanvillage.letter.3.page2:
I promise to sweep the chimney every week. Well, every month. Well... I'll try.

A thousand thanks,
%1$s
book.cleanvillage.letter.4.page1:
Dear %2$s,

Not a single cobweb! I checked under the bed three times and it's all sparkling.
book.cleanvillage.letter.4.page2:
You are the bravest person in the whole village. If the spiders come back, I know who to call.

Hugs,
%1$s
book.cleanvillage.letter.5.page1:
Dear %2$s,

My house is my home again. The lanterns are back, the light is back, even my wish to sing is back.
book.cleanvillage.letter.5.page2:
Let the pillagers tremble: now I have a friend who cleans faster than they can make a mess.

Thank you,
%1$s
villager.cleanvillage.sad.1: Look at this place... I have no strength left.
villager.cleanvillage.sad.2: This house used to sparkle, you know?
villager.cleanvillage.sad.3: Hmm... I don't feel like trading today.
villager.cleanvillage.sad.4: I can't even find my lanterns.
villager.cleanvillage.sad.5: Sorry, I'm not in the mood...
villager.cleanvillage.sad.7: If only someone would help me clean...
villager.cleanvillage.sad.8: Everything I need is in the chest by the bed... but I can't.
villager.cleanvillage.sad.9: Stains don't go away on their own, do they?
villager.cleanvillage.waiting.1: Keep going! I can see the difference!
villager.cleanvillage.waiting.2: I'll wait out here, I don't want to get in the way.
villager.cleanvillage.waiting.3: Is it looking better yet? I'm so nervous!
villager.cleanvillage.waiting.4: The sponge gets everything off, even the cobwebs!
